about: Catalog edits the Apps Script applies when the catalog is read with ?tab=Gifts&edits=1 (applyPendingEdits_ in docs/apps-script.gs). Each edit applies once, by id. set: change one cell only if it still holds `expect` and the row's Gift is `gift`. note: append ' | text' to Feedback. append: add a new gift row (ID left blank, filled automatically). Results go to the Edit log tab.

edits.text: Retired 10/3/26 per Dalia: hardwired and not on Amazon (old amzn.to link carried the Presently tag); replaced by the Keenray towel warmer bucket

values.Gift: BugView 5X Magnifier and Quick-Release Bug Catcher
values.Description: A one-handed bug catcher with a built-in 5X magnifier lets kids trap a beetle or spider, study it up close without touching it, and release it unharmed, which makes backyard bug hunts easy for small hands.
values.Feedback: Added 10/3/26 at Dalia's request (trending kids' magnifying glass) | Rating: 4.7 from 8,195 (Amazon), 4.87 from 31 (carson.com); seller: Carson Optical (NY optics maker, 30+ years), sold direct and at Amazon and Walmart; no BBB rating or Trustpilot page found | Best-reviewed kids' magnifier, proposed in place of the viral TikTok screen microscope, which sells only under generic house brands

edits.text: Retired 10/3/26 per Dalia: the LapLoom (same maker) is the better weaving gift

values.Gift: HG-6402P 8-Bar Curved Plug-In Heated Towel Rack, Mirror Polish
values.Description: An 8-bar curved towel warmer in mirror-polished stainless steel that mounts on the wall and plugs into a standard outlet, so no electrician is needed. It heats to about 130°F in 30 minutes, warming towels and drying them between showers.
values.Feedback: Added 10/3/26 to replace the Amba T-2536 (hardwired, not on Amazon); Dalia prefers a rack over a bucket. Rating: 4.3 from 73 (Amazon, B07GRLJBGP); the brushed (4.2 from 217) and matte black (3.8 from 48) finishes of this model fall short, so the mirror polish is the passing finish. Seller: Amazon listing sold by Just Bathrooms and shipped by Amazon (96% positive, 142 seller ratings); Heatgene Trustpilot is unclaimed with 1 review, no complaint pattern found. Price: $272.99 on Amazon and $272.99 on heatgene.com, in stock on both.

values.Gift: New York Times Premium Custom Birthday Book
values.Description: A library-bound book of New York Times front pages from the recipient's birthday in every year since they were born, with their name and birthdate foil-stamped on a black vegan leather cover. Birth years 1921 to 2005 are available.
values.Feedback: Added 10/3/26 from Uncommon Goods (Dalia's request) | Rating: 4.8 from 1,437 (Uncommon Goods; reviews before Oct 2024 cover the original edition); seller: Uncommon Goods. Uncommon Goods' own premium edition, made in Vermont; $160 adds a magnifying glass

values.Description: A cherry wood cribbage board laser-etched with a depth map of the lake they love, chosen from more than 7,500 lakes worldwide. Made in Michigan by Ashley Wiggins's family studio, with pegs stored in a corked compartment.
values.Feedback: Added 10/3/26 from Uncommon Goods (Dalia's request) | Rating: 4.8 from 1,181 (Uncommon Goods); seller: Uncommon Goods. Maker is Lake Art LLC (Harbor Springs, MI); cards not included

values.Gift: Intersection of Love Personalized Photo Print
values.Description: A black-and-white photo of two crossing street signs printed with a couple's names and the years that matter to them, by Philadelphia artist Patricia Carlin. Choose an unframed print, a framed print, or a milestone anniversary frame.
values.Feedback: Added 10/3/26 from Uncommon Goods (Dalia's request) | Rating: 4.9 from 1,653 (Uncommon Goods); seller: Uncommon Goods. Uncommon Goods exclusive and registered trademark (original design, 2013); $75 unframed, $125 framed, $175 anniversary frames; photo shows the framed print

values.Relation: Partner, Parent, Grandparent, Friend, Sibling, Coworker
values.Description: A hand-blown glass sphere in the recipient's birthstone color, made by Jill Henrietta Davis's studio in Pawtucket, Rhode Island. Its 52 paper slips hold one wish or note of thanks a week, and each stays inside for good.
values.Feedback: Added 10/3/26 from Uncommon Goods (Dalia's request) | Rating: 4.8 from 957 (Uncommon Goods); seller: Uncommon Goods. Original Wishing Ball design by Henrietta Glass; photo shows the September (sapphire) ball, buyer picks any month

values.Age: Child, Teenager, Young Adult, Adult, Senior
values.Description: A classic stereo viewer in red, blue, or black, plus a code for one custom reel of seven of your own photos. Image3D, founded in Oregon by a former View-Master employee, prints and mails the reel.
values.Feedback: Added 10/3/26 from Uncommon Goods (Dalia's request) | Rating: 4.8 from 956 (Uncommon Goods), 4.7 from 2,395 (Amazon); seller: Uncommon Goods, reel made by Image3D (Trustpilot 4.8 from 6,555). Image3D is the original custom-reel maker; extra reels $16.95

values.Description: A prepaid subscription that mails a detailed replica of a real historical document each month, such as Einstein's letter to Roosevelt or Rosa Parks's police report, with notes on its context. Plans run from six months to two years.
values.Feedback: Added 10/3/26 from Uncommon Goods (Dalia's request) | Rating: 4.8 from 202 (Uncommon Goods); seller: Uncommon Goods (History by Mail, seen on Shark Tank, has only 1 Trustpilot review). $48 for 6 months, $88 for 12, $165 for 2 years, $190 with folio

values.Description: Twenty-four vanilla shortbread cookies stamped with a message you choose, up to three short lines per cookie, baked by pastry chef Céline Zhou's Los Angeles bakery. They arrive in a yellow floral gift box.
values.Feedback: Added 10/3/26 from Uncommon Goods (Dalia's request) | Rating: 4.9 from 319 (Uncommon Goods); seller: Uncommon Goods. DeLight Patisserie also stocked by Neiman Marcus and Anthropologie; made to order, no cancellations

values.Description: A 20-page bedtime story that puts the child's name on the cover, throughout the text, and inside the illustrations as animals wish them sweet dreams. It comes in softcover or hardcover for ages 0 to 6.
values.Feedback: Added 10/3/26 from Uncommon Goods (Dalia's request) | Rating: 5.0 from 594 (Uncommon Goods), 4.7 from 138 (Amazon softcover); seller: Uncommon Goods. Made by I See Me! in Minnesota; Amazon link is the identical softcover

values.Gift: Robert Sabuda's Alice's Adventures in Wonderland Pop-Up Book
values.Description: Paper engineer Robert Sabuda's pop-up retelling of Lewis Carroll's story, where a storm of playing cards bursts off the page and the tea party rises in 3D. Adults who love books treasure it as much as children do.
values.Feedback: Added 10/3/26 from Uncommon Goods (Dalia's request) | Rating: 4.9 from 68 (Uncommon Goods, all titles), 4.9 from 3,117 (Amazon); seller: Uncommon Goods. Select Alice in Wonderland on the page ($40); photo is the publisher's (Simon & Schuster) interior spread, served without a content-type header

values.Gift: Sunshine Town DIY Book Nook Kit
values.Description: A laser-cut basswood kit that builds into a lit miniature street scene to slide between books on a shelf. The 246 pieces fit together without glue over about seven hours, and small LED lights make the alley glow.
values.Feedback: Added 10/3/26 from Uncommon Goods (Dalia's request) | Rating: 4.7 from 160 (Uncommon Goods, all scenes), 4.5 from 243 (Amazon, Sunshine Town); seller: Uncommon Goods. Rolife (Robotime) is the original DIY book nook kit brand; select Sunshine Town on the page, six other scenes $40 to $44; needs 2 AAA batteries
